name: A-B gap eutectic
_source: Synthetic system for validating invariant detection with composition sets: the regular solution ALPHA (L0 = 20000 J/mol, Tc = 1202.73 K) plus an ideal LIQUID whose end members both melt at 1000 K (dHfus = 10000 J/mol). Below the liquidus minimum the liquid decomposes eutectically into the two composition sets of ALPHA, symmetrically about x = 0.5.
